title: Marry Me Chicken
description: Pan-seared chicken cutlets simmered in a creamy sun-dried tomato and parmesan sauce that's famously persuasive. Rich, garlicky, and unrepentantly indulgent.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breasts
ingredients.notes: about 2 1/4 lbs, halved horizontally into 6 cutlets

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.notes: up to 3/4 cup for a saucier finish

steps.text: Season the chicken cutlets generously with salt and pepper on both sides. Dredge in flour, shaking off the excess.
steps.tip: For even cutlets, freeze the whole breasts for 20 minutes before slicing — the firmer flesh is much easier to halve horizontally.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, reduce to medium and add the butter. When it melts and foams, add the cutlets in batches. Cook until golden on the first side, about 5 minutes, then flip and cook another 4 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
steps.tip: Don't move the chicken once it hits the pan. A solid golden crust needs uninterrupted contact with hot fat.

steps.text: In the same skillet, add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Cook briefly until the paste darkens slightly.
Pour in the chicken stock and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Bring to a simmer.
Stir in the cream, reduce the heat to maintain a gentle simmer, and cook until the sauce thickens slightly, about 3 minutes. Stir in the parmesan and sun-dried tomatoes. Taste and adjust seasoning.
steps.tip: Watch the cream — a gentle simmer thickens the sauce evenly, a hard boil can break it.

steps.text: Nestle the chicken cutlets back into the sauce and simmer gently until cooked through (165°F internal), 5 to 10 minutes.
Scatter fresh basil over the top. Serve with crusty bread, pasta, or polenta to catch the sauce.
